test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The confluence of two holy rivers Alaknanda and Bhagirathi to form Ganga is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devprayag.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prayag** refers to the **confluence of rivers**.
 
• We can see five prayags known as **Panch Prayag** in **Uttarakhand** which also have a **religious significance**.
 
• **Devprayag** is the confluence of rivers **Alaknanda** and **Bhagirathi**.
 
• After this junction, the river is known as Ganga.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb2f30468fd9776e805d340df51ecbf9c55b9da665c2dc2fc773273528bd2ab8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vishnu Prayag**__

 __
 
• It is the confluence of rivers **Vishnu Ganga** and **Dhauli Ganga**
 
 
 
• **Nanda Prayag**__
 __
 
• It is the confluence of rivers **Alaknanda** and **Nandakini**.
 
 
 
• **Karna Prayag**__
 __
 
• It is the confluence of rivers **Alaknanda** and **Pindar Ganga**.
 
 
 
• **Rudra Prayag**__
 
 
• It is the confluence of rivers **Alaknanda** and **Mandakini**.
